# Work-package handoff

## Identity

- Work package and owner:
- Base commit / current commit / branch:
- Toolchain, target and feature profile:
- Source-lock revision/hash:
- State: not started / active / blocked / implemented-unverified / verified

## Contract and scope

- Requirement IDs and atomic children:
- Preconditions confirmed:
- Files owned/changed:
- Public interfaces changed and dependent consumers:
- Decisions/ADRs added:

## Evidence

| Requirement | Test/evidence ID | Exact command | Exit/result | Artifact |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Fill in | Fill in | Fill in | Do not infer | Path/hash |

## Unresolved work

- Known failing or skipped checks and consequences:
- Source ambiguities and proposed resolution:
- Reproducer for each defect:
- Resource/security/compatibility limits:
- What the next agent must not assume:

## Resume

- Next unmet gate:
- Next exact action and expected observable outcome:
- Independent work available while blocked:
- Shared files awaiting coordinator integration:

Never report a command as passed unless its output and exit status were observed. Keep secrets and operational payloads out of this handoff.
